01The person behind the code

More thana line of code.

I’m Sergio Alejandro Hernández Patiño, a .NET and Power Platform developer focused on full stack development, automation and AI integration.

My professional journey connects Colombia and Spain. I have worked in software development, consulting and development leadership, contributing from understanding a need through production deployment and the evolution of the solution.

I’m interested in how the pieces fit together: the interface someone uses, the logic behind it and the systems that need to talk to each other. Alejandro’sTech is where I bring together that journey and the things I build.

Technologies and applications

    Access authorisation for connecting services and working with APIs.
